title: Slovakian-Style Gluten-Free Pasta
description: A traditional Slovakian-inspired pasta dish made with unique gluten-free pasta, rigatoni, and a medley of vegetables.
instructions: Cook the rigatoni and unique pasta according to the package instructions.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 5 minutes, or until they begin to soften.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it cook while the pasta is cooking.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the vegetable mixture.
Toss the pasta to combine and serve hot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
